newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Radenska to be listed on Ljubljana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Radenska to be listed on Ljubljana bourse.

text.p: Slovenian health resort operator and mineral water producer Radenska will be listed on the main market of the Slovenian bourse, the Ljubljana Stock Exchange said on Monday.
The first day of trading had yet to be determined, it said.
Radenska will list 3.8 million shares with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars ($6.6) each, representing 75 percent of the company's equity.
Radenska will join a batch of 29 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the main and over-the-counter (OTC) markets of the Ljubljana bourse since January 1996.
At present 25 shares are traded on the main market and another 30 on the OTC.
